title: Grapefruit juice, red, not fortified, not from concentrate, refrigerated

content.title: About
content.content: Red grapefruit juice is made from ripe red grapefruits, not from concentrate, and contains no added sugars, vitamins, or other fortifiers. The juice is stored at 0 °C to 4 °C to preserve its freshness and bright flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Red juice contains more lycopene than regular pink or white grapefruit juice.
Grapefruit was first introduced to the United States from the Caribbean in the early 20th century.
Fresh‑pressed juice retains more vitamin C than juice made from concentrate.
The red color comes from carotenoids, which also have antioxidant properties.
Refrigerated juice better preserves aromatic compounds than juice kept at room temperature.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and aids collagen synthesis.

items.title: Contains lycopene
items.content: Lycopene is a powerful antioxidant that may reduce the risk of certain chronic diseases.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: One cup (250 ml) provides about 100 kcal, making it a good choice for weight management.

items.title: Supports hydration
items.content: The juice is mostly water and helps maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Provides potassium
items.content: Potassium supports normal heart and muscle function.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Grapefruit can increase the effect of certain medications, such as statins and some antihypertensives.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity may irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience an allergic reaction to citrus fruits.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the juice chilled as a refreshing beverage, use it in smoothies, cocktails, or as a base for sauces and marinades. If desired, add a touch of honey or fresh mint.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the juice refrigerated at 0–4 °C and consume within 5–7 days after opening. Do not freeze, as this can alter texture and flavor.
